title: Yard Requirements — Front, Side, and Rear Yards in R Districts
description: Yard regulations for Residence Districts: front yards (§23-32), side yards (§23-33), rear yards (§23-34). Includes permitted obstructions and through lot equivalents.

front_yards.r6_r12: Per §23-322: front yard requirements for R6 through R12 — generally no front yard required, but open area between street wall and street line has rules
front_yards.permitted_obstructions: Per §23-41 and §23-311/23-312: fences, retaining walls, steps, planting, canopies, etc. permitted in front yards
front_yards.notes: No front yard required in R6 through R12 per §23-342 exception. Open area between street wall and street line may be used for permitted obstructions.

side_yards.r6_r12: Per §23-335: side yard requirements for R6 through R12 — generally none required for Quality Housing contextual districts
side_yards.permitted_obstructions_in_side_yards: Per §23-311, §23-331: certain obstructions permitted in side yards
side_yards.notes: In Quality Housing contextual districts (R6A, R6B, R6D, R7A, R7B, R7D, R7X, R8A, R8B, R8X, R9A, R9D, R9X, R10A, R10X): no side yard required. Open lot pattern maintained.

rear_yards.r6_r12: Per §23-342: minimum 30 ft depth required for interior lots
rear_yards.exception: No rear yard required where rear lot line coincides with side lot line of an adjoining zoning lot
rear_yards.through_lots: Per §23-343: rear yard equivalent required on through lots ≥180 ft depth — provides light and air through mid-block
rear_yards.rear_yard_equivalent_through_lots: Options per §23-343: (a) open area along each side lot line ≥30 ft wide, OR (b) front setback areas ≥10 ft wide maintained, OR (c) open area ≥30 ft wide along each side lot line
rear_yards.certain_districts_through_lot_special_ru: In R5D, R6A, R6B, R6D, R7A, R7B, R7D, R7X, R8A, R8B, R8X, R9A, R9D, R9X, R10A, R10X, R11A: on through lots ≥180 ft, rear yard equivalent required ONLY per paragraph (a) — open area ≥30 ft along side lot lines
rear_yards.permitted_obstructions_rear_yard: Per §23-341: decks, parapets, stairs, porches, window sills, planters, solar panels, etc.

dob_filing_notes: Verify yard requirements based on district and lot configuration (interior vs. corner vs. through lot)
Through lots ≥180 ft: confirm whether §23-343 paragraph (a) applies or full rear yard equivalent required
Contextual districts (Quality Housing): typically no side yard — significant design flexibility
BSA variance may be needed for reduced rear yard — verify hardship criteria
